name: agentmash-lab
description: Ten science agents run by the agentmash crew's coordinator: a hypothesis scout with cross-field prior-art checks, a pre-registration registrar, a dataset curator, an analyst, a controls builder, an evidence judge, and four venue agents that take a judged paper to IEEE, Regeneron ISEF, an ML conference or a journal, sharing one protocol for pre-registration locks, provenance and PI approval gates.
